svg.aria-label: Two log-log panels of one-step error against noise level for DDIM and Heun under four 32-step schedules, peaking where the toy's structure and detail are decided
svg.text: ERROR OF ONE STEP STARTED ON THE EXACT PATH · 32 STEPS PER GRID · 32×32 CRESCENTS
σ AT THE END OF THE STEP (LOG)
σ AT THE END OF THE STEP (LOG)
Measured by the lab: each point is one step from the exact state at the previous grid point, compared with the exact state at its own (RK4 between).
Shaded: where the toy's structure is decided (σ ≈ 5–30, which crescent and how bright) and where its fine detail is (σ near τ = 0.1).
